definitions: Used to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, but is expected or desired to happen in the future.
Used as a response to a question about whether something has occurred, meaning it has not, but might.
examples: Have you finished your homework? Not yet.
The package has not yet arrived.
We haven't yet decided on a vacation spot.
Is dinner ready? Not yet, almost.
They have not yet announced the winner.
